scope: Interpret raw native trace APIs without conflating initial executable preparation with device-loop decisions.
observations: The warmed full-solve profile contains one graph launch and one final external synchronization, with no executable instantiation/upload APIs.
The first loop graph launch records deferred cudaGraphInstantiateWithFlags and cudaGraphUpload before its single graph launch. These occur once outside the five device-controlled phases.

All DOT copies are device-to-device; no HOST, MEMALLOC or MEMFREE nodes are recorded. No explicit allocation/free or host-copy APIs are recorded. This is not a claim about driver-internal preparation work or storage.
Array/workspace construction and final output readback occur outside the trace; profiling durations are diagnostic.
